account.notSignedIn: Not signed in: local profiles on this device

guest.title: Profiles Saved as a Guest
guest.description: This browser has profiles that were saved without an account. If they are yours, use them for this account. If they belong to someone else, start fresh: they stay with the guest.
guest.passphraseNote: They were saved with a passphrase. Enter it once to move them (Aullevo won't ask for it again).
guest.use: Yes, use them for this account
guest.freshNote: Each account and the guest keep their own profiles. Nothing is shared between them.

upgrade.title: Enter Your Passphrase One Last Time
upgrade.description: Aullevo no longer uses a passphrase. Enter yours once more to open your profiles; after that, Aullevo opens straight away and never asks again.
upgrade.forgot: Forgot it? Start over (deletes these profiles)

reset.confirm:
Start over?

This deletes the profiles, documents, AI memories, link queue and API keys saved for {account} on this device. It cannot be undone. Other accounts are not affected.
